candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in the inventory service, causing inventory POST /v1/reservations to return 503 and propagating ReadTimeout 502s up through order and gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics or logs admitted; root cause of the redis timeouts (load, saturation, network) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable, inventory returning 503, and order/gateway returning 502 ReadTimeout, matching the alert's ~2s 502s. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis. Metrics show checkout 502s and elevated p95 latency. Bounded to redis-timeout; underlying redis cause unproven.
